text:
deploy-bot: starting config-only rollout — geo-steer + batch cap. Canary 3% for 15m, change window 18:00-20:00 UTC. Diff: geo_steer: prefer eu-central, spill_to: us-east; batch_max_tokens=12; per_router_concurrency=4; request_timeout_ms=1300. Health posts every 3m.

rachel: context — recent kvcache + kernel fixes reduced steady latency but p99 spikes remain in EU. No model pinning. Exclude tenant-alpha and load-sim from canary.

tom: +1 exclude tenant-alpha, also QoS floor: ensure tenant-critical retains min throughput.

elena: rollback rules: abort if eu p99 > 1000ms OR total_error_rate increases >1.8% abs OR infra_ooms >=2 in 10m. Also abort if streaming tail-duration increases by >500ms.

rachel: runbook snippet for ops channel:

```yaml
change: config-only
canary:
  initial_pct: 3
  durations_min: 15
  step_up: [10,40]
geo_steer:
  prefer: eu-central-1
  spill_to: us-east-1
batching:
  max_tokens: 12
  per_router_concurrency: 4
timeouts_ms: 1300
exclusions: [tenant-alpha, load-sim]
qos:
  preserve_min_throughput_for: tenant-critical
rollback_triggers:
  eu_p99_ms: 1000
  error_rate_abs_pct: 1.8
  infra_ooms_10m: 2
  streaming_tail_delta_ms: 500
```

deploy-bot: canary started 2026-10-15T18:02:30Z. Observability: /dash/geo-steer, /dash/batch-samples. Alerts ping @rachel @elena.

(3m) oncall-bot: health: eu p50 60ms p95 280ms p99 890ms, error_rate +0.2%, kv_cache_miss +0.5% — within thresholds.

(9m) tom: one router reported queue-length spike; autoscaler drained and replaced node, traffic rebalanced, no client errors.

(16m) elena: green to advance to 10%. Hold 30m then to 40% if stable.

rachel: release note draft: "Config-only: geo-steering toward eu-central with spill to us-east; batch cap reduced to 12 tokens; request timeout 1300ms; canary 3% -> 10% -> 40%; exclusions tenant-alpha, load-sim; QoS preserved for tenant-critical; rollback conditions documented."

deploy-bot: commands available: `/deploybot abort-config`, `/deploybot list-exclusions`, `/deploybot qos-check`. Next health post in 3m with top slow traces and sample logs.
